specs: Explore 50+ square miles of Assateague Bay

blurb: Guests can take 1-hour guided jet ski tours led by Maryland-certified guides across Assateague Bay, seeing wild horses, dolphins, and open water. Alternatively, guests can rent self-captained pontoon boats for 2 to 8 hours, accommodating up to 10 guests, with the freedom to explore the bay, anchor near Assateague Island, swim at sandbars, and enjoy sunsets.
